title: Design System: Yilin Cai Personal Portfolio

modal.enter: opacity + scale 0.96 to 1 + y 12 to 0 over 280ms

motion.reducedMotion: Disable transform-heavy movement and keep content visible by default.

componentNotes.floatingProofCards: Use 4-7 real portfolio proof cards in hero or key sections; avoid fake SaaS metrics.
componentNotes.growthMap: Internship map cards should summarize product, problem, contribution, and value.
componentNotes.projectTiles: Prefer image-first case-study cards with varied weight over identical repeated cards.

rules.limeSignalRule: Use lime for buttons, active states, dots, and keywords only; keep it rare.
rules.skyFirstRule: Use sky blue for immersive first impression, then let white and gray surfaces carry portfolio content.
rules.airNotGlassRule: Use transparency and blur only for sky/floating depth, not decorative glassmorphism.
rules.oneBigSentenceRule: Each major section gets one dominant statement; supporting detail moves into cards.
